$schema_note: Model governance manifest. Every artifact ships with a SHA-256 so CI and operators can detect corruption or unapproved swaps. Run `python scripts/verify_models.py` to verify (also runs in CI). If you replace a model, update this file in the same commit.

models.purpose: Real-time 33-keypoint pose detection for the live monitoring pipeline and video analysis
models.notes: Runtime-critical. Absence disables live mode (API fails closed with 503 in live mode).

models.source: Trained in-repo (scripts/train_svm.py on the Kaggletask keypoint dataset)
models.runtime: training-only — NOT loaded by the running API
models.notes: Not referenced by backend_api/app or backend/services at runtime; kept for the training/eval pipeline.

models.format: scikit-learn pickle (Gradient Boosting / Random Forest risk classifier)
models.purpose: Legacy image-classification risk model from the pre-MediaPipe pipeline
models.source: Trained in-repo (legacy scripts) on the Kaggle posture dataset
models.version: archived — superseded by rule-based feature scoring in backend/services/features.py
models.runtime: archived — NOT loaded by the running API
models.notes: Kept for provenance and A/B comparison; the live pipeline scores risk from biomechanical features, not this classifier.

models.purpose: Task/activity classifier v2 — model-primary with Gaussian fallback (confidence-gated)
models.source: Trained in-repo (scripts/train_task_model_v2.py) on synthetic poses validated against the Gaussian scorer
models.runtime: production — loaded lazily; missing/corrupt model falls back to the Gaussian scorer
models.notes: 19 feature columns (17 biomechanical + movement_velocity + wrist_movement_velocity). Confidence threshold 0.6.

models.purpose: REBA-informed risk band cross-check (LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH) — advisory overlay, does NOT replace rule-based risk
models.source: Trained in-repo (scripts/train_risk_calibration.py) on 30,698 REBA-labeled real-world poses (rebapose/COCO-derived)
models.runtime: optional — advisory cross-check; rule-based risk_from_features stays authoritative
models.notes: Holdout accuracy 91.8% on REBA band. See reports/risk_calibration_report.md for rule-vs-REBA agreement.

policy.replace_model_workflow: Commit the new binary AND update its sha256/size_bytes in this file in the same commit — CI verify_models.py fails otherwise.
policy.large_artifacts: These binaries are git-tracked (~9 MB total). If models grow past ~50 MB, migrate to Git LFS.
policy.verification: python scripts/verify_models.py  (checksum + size; CI runs this on every push)
